_note: Sipeed Tang Nano 20K — Gowin GW2AR-LV18QN88C8/I7 FPGA (20736 LUT4 / 15552 FF, 64 Mbit SDRAM in package). 2x20P 2.54 mm headers, 34 free IOs. Board 54.04 x 22.55 mm. 3.3 V logic — NOT 5 V tolerant, on every header bank (BANK0/1/3/5/6 all V_IO=3.3 V). The 5 V header pin is the USB rail and is an OUTPUT: powering a 5 V part from it is fine, returning 5 V into a bank pin destroys the FPGA. Pins 15-20 also drive onboard LED0-LED5 and pin 79 the WS2812, so those header pins are not electrically free. Terminal names are FPGA pin numbers (pXX), which is what a Gowin .cst constraint uses.
_pinmap_source: Sipeed Tang Nano 20K Datasheet v1.3 (Shenzhen Sipeed Technology), Pinout page, cross-checked against the wiki pin-label diagram and litex-boards litex_boards/platforms/sipeed_tang_nano_20k.py (BSD-2-Clause, (c) 2023 Icenowy Zheng). Where LiteX disagrees the datasheet wins: LiteX places 75/76 on opposite headers and swaps 25/26, and the datasheet's own revision history records 'Fixed the issue of pinout picture', so the 2023 LiteX file predates that correction. Dimensions and the 2.54 mm pitch are from the datasheet's mechanical drawing; the 20.32 mm (8-pitch) header span is measured from it. Datasheet facts, no library copied. See docs/TANG-NANO-20K-PINOUT.md.
